note: Grade 5 persuasive first draft at the emerging tier: short sentences, one repeated phrase, one reason without an example.

assignment.title: Should school uniforms be required?
assignment.instructions: Write an opinion about school uniforms. Give two reasons and one example.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.text: I think that school uniforms are good. I think that school uniforms are fair.

sections.label: Body
sections.text: First, uniforms save time in the morning. I think that everyone looks the same. This is good because nobody is judged.

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.text: I think that uniforms are good for our school.

strengths: The opinion is clear from the first sentence.
improvements: Add one reason after your opinion so the reader knows why.
sections.evidence: I think that school uniforms are good
sections.why: The task asks for an opinion and a reason.
sections.nextStep: Write one sentence that says why uniforms are good.

strengths: You used First to start the reason.
improvements: Say how uniforms save time with one small example.
sections.evidence: First, uniforms save time in the morning
sections.why: An example lets the reader see the reason.
sections.nextStep: Add one sentence that starts with For example.

strengths: The last sentence repeats your main idea.
improvements: End with one new idea about the future, not only the same opinion.
sections.evidence: I think that uniforms are good for our school
sections.why: A closing idea helps the reader remember the point.
sections.nextStep: Write one sentence about how uniforms help next year.

overall.summary: You have a clear opinion and you used First to order your reason. Next, add one example so the reader can see it.
nextPriorities: Add one example about time in the morning.
Join two short sentences with because.
